note: Per-sport coverage status for the 21-27 October 2026 window. Every status below is what actually happened in this build - nothing is padded or assumed.

ice-hockey.detail: Four NHL fixtures verified directly from the NHL's official schedule API.

basketball.detail: Eleven NBA fixtures verified from NBA.com. All twelve clubs opened 2026-27 at 0-0, so no club carries a current-season rating and every pick is capped at low confidence.

baseball.detail: Four World Series games verified from MLB's official schedule and postseason endpoints, with full 2026 records and home/road splits.

snooker.detail: Eleven Round 2 matches at the BetVictor Northern Ireland Open verified from WST, with official world ranking positions.

darts.detail: Seven first-round ties at the Machineseeker European Championship verified from the PDC's published schedule. The PDC Order of Merit could not be retrieved (cookie interstitial), so no darts match carries a rating input.

cricket.detail: Seven fixtures verified from New Zealand Cricket's official fixtures service, including both BLACKCAPS v India T20 internationals and three Ford Trophy openers.

rugby-union.detail: Five Gallagher Premiership Round 4 fixtures are listed, but Premiership Rugby's own fixtures page is client-rendered and returned no rows. These rows are marked CROSS-CHECKED, not verified, and appear on the Flagged for Review page.

motor-racing.detail: Round 18, the United States Grand Prix (23-25 October), is verified from the official Formula 1 calendar. The circuit name and race start time were not captured and are deliberately left blank.

golf.detail: The Butterfield Bermuda Championship (22-25 October, Port Royal Golf Course) is verified from PGA TOUR. Stroke-play golf has no two-sided fixture to price, and the field was not verified, so no betting row is published.

gaelic-football.detail: Verified negative. The GAA's official fixtures calendar shows no Gaelic football fixture between 21 and 25 October 2026. The only October fixture published is the Shinty-Hurling international between Ireland and Scotland on 24 October, which is hurling and therefore out of scope.

rugby-league.detail: No official Rugby League fixture source was retrieved in this build. Not claimed either way - flagged.

handball.detail: No official handball fixture source was retrieved in this build. Flagged.

volleyball.detail: No official volleyball fixture source was retrieved in this build. Flagged.

tennis.detail: The official ATP scores feed was readable, but the tournament names behind this week's events were not captured and no fixture list was assembled. Flagged.

aussie-rules.detail: No official AFL fixture source was retrieved for the window. Flagged.

esports.detail: eSports has no single governing body and no official fixture source was retrieved. Flagged.

greyhounds.detail: GBGB racecards were not retrieved in this build. Flagged.
